content.text:
Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Repo indkhan/Moneo. Work on GitHub issue #239 (read it with `gh issue view 239`, and AGENTS.md). This is PR 2 of several, one area per PR. PR 1 (#294, own-transfers) shows the pattern: lib/finance functions take a plain `{ locale, timezone, now }`-style context from the caller instead of loading settings themselves.

Your area is the financial review pipeline: `lib/finance/review-freshness.ts`, `lib/finance/review-gather.ts`, `lib/finance/review-loader.ts`, `lib/finance/review-request.ts`. They call `loadWorkspaceSettings` and `requireAiScope` from `@/lib/settings` and type against `requireWorkspace` from `@/lib/auth`.

Owner's decision: callers (pages, route handlers, server actions, chat/voice tools, `workflows/financial-review.ts`) resolve the owner/workspace, settings, AI data scopes and clock; lib/finance takes plain inputs (db client, workspace id, the narrow settings needed, the allowed scopes, `now`). Authorization (the AI scope checks) must stay enforced at every public entry point: move each `requireAiScope` call to the caller, or pass the already-checked scopes in. Never lose a check: for every entry point that reaches these functions, list in the PR body where its scope check now happens. Replace the `typeof requireWorkspace` types with a plain structural type. Type-only or constant imports (`AiDataScope`, `AI_DATA_SCOPES`) can stay for now; a later PR moves them. No DI framework. Behaviour must not change. Don't add the lint ban yet. Leave other lib/finance files alone.

Steps: create branch `t3/issue-239-review` from origin/main. Run existing tests first. Migrate the files and every caller (`git grep`). Drop request-state `vi.mock`s from tests where they become unnecessary. Commit in steps. Before opening the PR, merge origin/main again (keep main's changes on conflicts; run `npm run feature-map` and `npm run db:types` only if lint/CI need them).

Rules: run `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` yourself and quote their last lines. Tests use only the moneo-qa test backend; never the owner's backend (.env, Docker project `moneo`, port 3000). Never run `qa:reset` or `docker compose -p moneo-qa down`. Never kill a process you didn't start (verify by PID). Don't end your turn while a command is still running. No comments in code. Commits end with "Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>". Open the PR (body ends with "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)"), never merge it. Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>.

## What changed

- `review-loader.ts`: `loadFinancialReviewEvidence(db, workspace, { timezone, scopes, now }, query?)`. No settings object, no `requireAiScope`, no `new Date()`.
- `review-freshness.ts`: `reviewFreshness(db, workspace, saved, settings, now)`. It no longer loads settings (the three callers already hold them from `requireWorkspace`) and no longer types against `requireWorkspace`; the context handed to `readEvidenceView` is typed from that function's own parameter.
- `review-gather.ts`: no `@/lib/settings` function imports or `requireWorkspace` type. The caller passes `settings(db)`, `requireScopes` and `now()`. These are functions, not values, because the gatherer deliberately re-reads settings after each query to catch a scope revoked mid-run; that behaviour is unchanged.
- `review-request.ts`: only imports the `AI_DATA_SCOPES` constant, which is allowed to stay, so it is untouched.
- Tests: the `@/lib/settings` mock is gone from `review-gather.test.ts`; loader and freshness tests pass plain inputs instead of parsed settings.

## Where each scope check now happens

| Entry point | Check |
| --- | --- |
| Chat tool `reviews_investigate` (`app/api/chat/route.ts`) | `aiEvidence(["accounts","transactions"], ...)` before and after the read, as before |
| Evidence page / API `reviews_investigate` receipts (`readEvidenceView`) | `requireAiScope(receipt.scopes)` at the top as before, plus an explicit `requireAiScope(accounts, transactions)` in that case, replacing the one the loader did |
| Workflow `gatherEvidence`, non-request path (`workflows/financial-review.ts`) | `reviewScopes(settings)` already ran before; it now runs again immediately before the loader call |
| Workflow `gatherEvidence`, request path (`gatherReviewInvestigation`) | workflow passes `requireScopes: requireAiScope` and `settings: loadWorkspaceSettings`; the gatherer's per-read and post-read checks are the same calls through those |
| `/ai/activity/[id]` page and `/api/analysis/[id]` (`reviewFreshness`) | `reviewFreshness` returns `unknown` when `accounts` or `transactions` is off (it used to throw inside its own try/catch and return the same `unknown`); it runs no query in that case |
| `readEvidenceView` freshness check of retained receipts (called by `reviewFreshness`) | unchanged: `requireAiScope(receipt.scopes)` |

Voice calls reach the evidence through the same chat route tool, so they use the same check.

The PR is open and the four review-pipeline files no longer read request state. `review-request.ts` needed no change because it only imports the `AI_DATA_SCOPES` constant.

- **Checks:** `npm test` passed (1863 passed, 17 skipped). `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` came back clean, and `npm run build` succeeded.
- **Scope checks:** the PR body lists, for each entry point, where its scope check now happens. They stay enforced everywhere, in two ways:
  - `loadFinancialReviewEvidence` no longer checks scopes itself. The workflow and `readEvidenceView` now call `requireAiScope(accounts, transactions)` before it. The chat tool already checks through `aiEvidence`.
  - `gatherReviewInvestigation` keeps its re-reads that catch a scope revoked mid-run. The workflow passes it `settings`, `requireScopes` and `now` as functions.
- **Freshness check:** `reviewFreshness` takes the caller's settings and clock. It still returns `unknown` when accounts or transactions are off.
- **Tests:** the `@/lib/settings` mock is gone from `review-gather.test.ts`. The loader and freshness tests pass plain inputs.
- **Merge:** `origin/main` was already merged in; there were no conflicts.
- **Commits:** there are two, one for the loader and freshness check and one for the gatherer.
